    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        total_games = n * (n - 1) // 2
        base_points = (n - 1) * 3 // n
        extra_points = (n - 1) % n
        points = [base_points] * n
        for i in range(extra_points):
            points[i] += 3
        game_results = []
        current_game = 0
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                if points[i] > points[j]:
                    game_results.append(1)
                    points[i] -= 3
                    points[j] += 0
                elif points[i] < points[j]:
                    game_results.append(-1)
                    points[i] += 0
                    points[j] -= 3
                else:
                    game_results.append(0)
                    points[i] -= 1
                    points[j] -= 1
                current_game += 1
        results.extend(game_results)
    print(" ".join(map(str, results)))
